messages:
jordan_hw: Heads up — NovaChip asked for an end-to-end perf/W and kernel-tuning run on their new A100-equivalent board. Want to align scope, required metrics, and deliverables. Hoping to include throughput, watts @ P95, and kernel-flag delta analysis.
laura_pm: Timeline? They want something before their partner summit on 2027-07-12. Can we commit to a dry run + public joint bench by then? :calendar:
 dmitri_perf: We should split into microbench (matmul, attention), inference single-model runs (seq len 512/2048), and an end-to-end app workload. Also a perf/W curve sweep at 50/75/100% power caps. Targets: 2% measurement error, 3 runs per point.
 sarah_ops: For infra we'll need dedicated nodes in our staging pool with telemetry enabled (power sensors + perf counters). I'll reserve 4 nodes for a 3-day window. Need partner access for kernel pushes?
 kevin_partner: (NovaChip) We can provide a kernel tree and a small test rig next week. Want Redwood to validate our tuning choices and provide a short joint statement if results look good.
 dmitri_perf: Agreed. Proposed deliverables: measurement notebook (CSV + graphs), flamegraphs for kernel hotspots, a short playbook on which kernel knobs moved latency/energy, and a one-slide partner summary.
 laura_pm: That sounds right. Who will own the public writeup? I suggest marketing + partner comms but bench team provides the data.
 jordan_hw: Redwood owns the benchmark reproducibility (scripts + container). Marketing will own the press asset. Partner provides kernel patches and hardware access.
 sarah_ops: Quick checklist: 1) staging node reservation (done) 2) kernel repo access (partner) 3) power telemetry agent build 4) bench harness + env spec 5) runbook for flaky traces
 dmitri_perf: I'll author the bench harness changes. Basic run command (for reproducibility):
```bash
./run_redwood_bench --model /models/gpt2-1.5b --seq 2048 --batch 1 --sweep power:50,75,100 --kernel-branch partners/novachip-tune --reps 3 --output results/novachip-2027-07-01.csv
```
 jordan_hw: Nice — include flags to pin CPU governor and disable turbo. Also capture NVML and RAPL readings.
 kevin_partner: We'll provide a small helper to flash power sensors and a KVM for console access. I can DM creds.
 bench_bot: Job scheduled: bench:novachip:dryrun on 2027-07-01T09:00Z (ID: job_5231). Logs -> https://ci.redwood.inf/jobs/job_5231/logs
 laura_pm: For public timeline: draft by 2027-07-05, legal review 2 business days, announce at partner summit 2027-07-12 if cleared.
 dmitri_perf: Quick note on kernel delta analysis: capture baseline + tuned with consistent workloads; produce per-call latency CDF and perf/W curves. I can script the graphs in the notebook.
 jordan_hw: OK folks — action items: @dmitri_perf write harness + graphs, @sarah_ops reserve nodes + infra, @kevin_partner provide kernel tree + creds, @laura_pm coordinate marketing timeline. I'll sync with NovaChip on scope doc. :thumbsup:
 kevin_partner: I'll upload kernel tarball by EOD tomorrow and share repo link here.
 sarah_ops: Added runbook skeleton to /ops/bench/novachip/runbook.md and enabled telemetry on reserved nodes.
 bench_bot: bench:novachip:dryrun completed (job_5231) — status: partial (some runs failed due to firmware mismatch). See logs: https://ci.redwood.inf/jobs/job_5231/logs
 dmitri_perf: Saw the failed runs. I'll triage firmware mismatch and re-run. If partner firmware is required, we need a signed checksum.
 kevin_partner: Firmware mismatch noted — pushing fixed image now. Will post checksum and a short upgrade note.
 laura_pm: Great, keep the public comms draft on hold until we have clean results. Thanks all.
